exclusions: Raw numeric/RGB/DINO/weight payloads, exported PNGs and detailed private reports are not copied.
reproduction_limits: Most original analyses imported the development report tree, not collector875; source pins distinguish analysis from trajectory generation.
All original scripts are byte-identical to the local files and to recorded script hashes where present. Do not edit them in this archive to make them generally runnable.
The package contains code and small metadata only. Private closed numeric/raw captures and earlier small reports are necessary on the original research machine.
Clock values, absolute output paths, growing results indexes and filesystem state can change on rerun; a new report is a new measurement, not a bytewise recreation of historical output.
Assertions are output guards in several scripts; optimized Python would remove them. Use ordinary Python and a fresh private output directory, never the archived directory.
Archival verification uses AST parsing and byte/hash comparison only. No original audit, trajectory, training, rendering or image export was rerun.
